tex_content.html:
Proposition
[Unique lifting property]

↗ def:lift-of-a-map

1. ch1:1.34\group Covering Spaces

If $Y$ is connected and two lifts of $f:Y\to X$ agree at one point, they agree everywhere.

Proof

\sketch The equalizer of the two lifts is open and closed: near an agreement point both images lie in one sheet, while distinct sheets separate a point of disagreement.

□
